scenes.heading: How scenefile times a scene
scenes.say: This is how scenefile decides how long each scene stays on screen.

scenes.text: Nobody sets durations. They come from the text.
scenes.say: You never set a duration. Scenefile works it out from how long the text takes to read.

scenes.caption: packages/engine/src/resolve.ts
scenes.say: Each scene type says how long its content needs. The engine adds the time to arrive and the time to leave.

before.label: With narration
before.text: The scene waits for the voice to finish.

after.label: Without
after.text: The scene lasts as long as it takes to read.

scenes.say: If a scene is narrated, it also waits until the line has been said.

scenes.heading: Read it in resolve.ts.
scenes.say: The whole rule is in one file, resolve dot t s.
